shipped_rows.title_o: Children learn spurious associations in their math textbooks: Examples from fraction arithmetic.
shipped_rows.outcome_quote: Overall, these results complement the findings of Braithwaite and Siegler (2018), suggesting that children learn spurious association from their textbook fraction arithmetic problem distributions.
